name: Deep-washout triple reversion, calm (5m)
rationale: The reversion analogue of the triple-confirm trend spec: on 5m, a deeply negative band z-score AND an oversold RSI AND a low realized vol must all agree before buying. Statistical distance, momentum exhaustion, and calm regime together isolate the highest-quality snapback setups and reject the false oversolds that any single filter admits. The other side is the last panic seller into a quiet book. Edge persists because triple-confirmed exhaustion in a calm tape reverts reliably. Distinct from the double-oversold spec by adding the vol regime gate and running at 5m. Disconfirmer: exits when RSI recovers past its exit level, or the stop fires if the washout was a genuine breakdown.
catalyst: triple-confirmed oversold in a calm regime
